blocks.text: Deer Lake homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Deer Lake, September 2026. Detached houses: 13 listed at month end and 1 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market). No condos and townhomes were listed or sold in Deer Lake between June and September.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 3 sold over 4 months against an average of 12.5 listed, about 16.7 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 1 sold.

faq.q: What is in Deer Lake Park?
faq.a: Walking trails and a boardwalk around the lake, a boat launch and picnic areas, and Burnaby's cultural precinct: the Shadbolt Centre for the Arts, the Burnaby Art Gallery, Burnaby Village Museum and Hart House restaurant, all connected by the park's trails; the park is open dawn to dusk year-round.

faq.q: Is Deer Lake the same sub-area as Deer Lake Place or Upper Deer Lake?
faq.a: No. In the SnapStats GVR report, Deer Lake, Deer Lake Place and Upper Deer Lake are three separate Burnaby sub-areas with separate inventory and solds; Deer Lake itself recorded 13 detached listings, 1 detached sold and no attached listings in September 2026 (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What should I check before renovating a house near the lake?
faq.a: Whether the property is on the City's heritage register or inside the Deer Lake Park Heritage Precinct on Sperling Avenue — listed houses such as the 1912 Woodward House at 5195 Sperling Avenue carry heritage review — and the parcel's zone and R1 SSMUH eligibility under the 2026 Zoning Bylaw.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Deer Lake?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses listed with 1 sold in the month in Deer Lake. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Deer Lake a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 8%, a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
